text: Pulsee Luce e Gas is the digital retail energy brand of Axpo Italia, a subsidiary of Axpo Holding AG. Axpo is 100% publicly owned: all its shares sit with the cantons of northeastern Switzerland and their utilities, with Canton Zurich and its cantonal utility alone holding roughly 36%.
short: Pulsee Luce e Gas is the digital retail energy brand of Axpo Italia, a subsidiary of Axpo Holding AG.

source.name: Axpo Group, 'Owners - Entirely in public hands'
source.quote: All of Axpo Holding AG shares are owned by the cantons of Northeastern Switzerland and the cantonal utilities.
